input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show six business processes arranged in a neat 2-row by 3-column grid of identical rounded-square tiles with even gutters and nothing drawn in the gutters. All six tiles have the identical pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted or darker tile, one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds of the tile, and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so that every label fits comfortably on one line with clear empty padding on both sides. The icons contain no lettering at all. Tile 1: a new-starter badge with a laptop and a check mark; label exactly 'Employee Onboarding'. Tile 2: a purchase request form with a stamp and a small cart; label exactly 'Purchase Approvals'. Tile 3: an invoice with a coin and a green tick; label exactly 'Invoice Approval'. Tile 4: a calendar with a sun and a tick; label exactly 'Leave Requests'. Tile 5: a ticket with a wrench and a monitor; label exactly 'IT & Facilities Tickets'. Tile 6: a clipboard with a shield and a check mark; label exactly 'Compliance Reviews'. A single small yellow spark sits near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no connecting lines, no arrows between tiles, no dotted paths anywhere. The only text in the image is the six tile labels, all bold and perfectly spelled.
